title: The Object Detective
audience: Grades 8–12, first-year undergraduates, online museum visitors
summary: A draft museum label makes bold claims. Examine real CC0 Smithsonian 3D scans under raking light, magnify and measure them, weigh the catalog records, and write a corrected label that says what you know and how sure you are.

poster.alt: A real Smithsonian 3D scan of the 1844 Morse-Vail telegraph key on a grey inspection backdrop, lit by a low raking light that throws its lever's shadow across the wooden base
